statement.p: Consider each of the following scenarios/processes. Identify each one as an atomic process or a more complex, non-atomic process. As a reminder, atomic processes cannot be decomposed into smaller, sub-processes.

ol.li:
The rolling of three 20-sided die.
Atomic
Non-Atomic

The rolling of a single 60-sided die.
Atomic
Non-Atomic

Choosing a single donut from a donut shop that sells many different types of donut.
Atomic
Non-Atomic

Choosing a donut and a drink from a donut shop that sells many different types of donut and has a large drink menu.
Atomic
Non-Atomic

Dealing out a pair of cards from a standard 52-card deck.
Atomic
Non-Atomic

Dealing out a second card from a standard 52-card deck after a first card has been dealt out.
Atomic
Non-Atomic
